text:
meera: Quick Q  we have a VIP visitor (S. Patel) arriving tomorrow. Do we put them on the executive parking list?
frontdesk-bot: @meera please add S. Patel to the executive list in the admin sheet. Executive spots limited to 2.
meera: Added. Parking pass will need to be on windshield. Also, can we get a reserved sign on spot E1?
people-ops: We can request a reserved cone for E1. Facilities will handle the cone placement 15 minutes before arrival.
dan: FYI their laptop is arriving separately via courier this afternoon. Tracking 49X-PTL. It might be signed by Front Desk. Please watch for a "Redwood - Confidential" package.
frontdesk-bot: Package note: courier 'PriorityNow' delivered at 13:02 to front desk. Logged as "S. Patel laptop". In Locker L1.
ryan: I'll pick it up around 14:30 and bring to 2A. Also, do we have a spare dongle kit?
louise: AV kit available in 2A, includes HDMI, USB-C dongle, and adaptor.
people-ops: Reminder to hosts: use the VIP badge (gold stripe) and return to reception after meeting. We also need a signed NDA if guest requests internal docs.
meera: Thanks! Also ordered lunch via OfficeEats for 4, arriving 12:45. Please keep it in the pantry under 'VIP'.
frontdesk-bot: Reception will label lunch. Note: please notify if dietary restrictions.
dan: No restrictions. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
